license_required.quote: only qualified persons be permitted to engage in the practice of optometry in the state of Louisiana

issuing_authority.value: Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health

name.value: Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners
name.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health

type.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health and is subject to the provisions of R.S. 36:803.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Louisiana State Board of Optometry Examiners is created within the Louisiana Department of Health

moral_character_required.quote: Be citizens of the United States or possess valid and current legal authority to reside and work in the United States duly issued by the Citizenship and Immigration Services agency of the United States Department of Homeland Security, and be of good moral character.

degree_required.quote: Have graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board and hold the graduate level Doctor of Optometry degree.

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved school or college of optometry
accrediting_body.quote: Have graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board

exams.name: Board examination (state)
exams.notes: Based on subjects taught in approved schools and colleges of optometry
exams.quote: Pass the examination required by R.S. 37:1051.

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination
exams.notes: Required score level set by the board
exams.quote: Have reached the required level of performance on those parts of the examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry required by the board

exams.name: Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease examination (NBEO)
exams.notes: Passing this exam satisfies the didactic education requirement for therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certification
exams.quote: If the applicant passes the Treatment and Management of Ocular Disease examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or other examination as approved by the board pertaining to the use of pharmaceutical agents and the treatment and management of ocular disease, the applicant shall be deemed to have met the requirement for additional studies in didactic education.

interval_years.quote: All licensed optometrists shall annually: (1) Pay to the board the annual renewal fee

required.quote: accompany the payment of the annual renewal fee with evidence satisfactory to the board of attendance and completion of twelve hours of continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: If the licensee is authorized to diagnose and treat pathology and to use and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, accompany the payment of the annual renewal fee with evidence satisfactory to the board of attendance and completion of sixteen hours of continuing education.

value: Half of required hours shall pertain to ocular and systemic pharmacology and current diagnosis and treatment of ocular disease, obtained through in-person classroom setting
No more than six hours from online education sources
topical_requirements.quote: Half of the required hours of continuing education shall pertain to ocular and systemic pharmacology and current diagnosis and treatment of ocular disease and shall be obtained through an in-person classroom setting.

available.quote: The board may waive the examination provided in R.S. 37:1051 if the applicant presents to the board a satisfactory certificate of registration from a board of optometry examiners of another state

requirements.value: Applicant must present a satisfactory certificate of registration from another state's board of optometry examiners, and that state's standards must be equal to Louisiana's requirements.
requirements.quote: if the standard of requirements adopted and enforced by such board is equal to that provided in this Chapter.

regulatory_model.quote: only qualified persons be permitted to engage in the practice of optometry in the state of Louisiana

credential_type.quote: he shall, within ninety days of the examination date, pay all applicable fees including the original license fee and the original therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certificate fee and shall receive from the board under its seal certificates entitling him to practice optometry in this state.

is_mandatory.quote: No person practicing optometry without a current, valid license or temporary permit shall have the right to receive any compensation for services so rendered.

title_protection.quote: Advertised or held himself out to be an optometrist without having a valid certificate issued by the board.

scope_protection.quote: Levy a civil penalty of no more than five thousand dollars per offense upon any unlicensed person who, after a hearing or informal resolution in accordance with all provisions of the Administrative Procedure Act and this Chapter, is found to have practiced optometry without benefit of a current valid license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced optometry in violation of this Chapter or permitted unlicensed persons to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced or assisted in the practice of optometry, or knowingly permitted or has permitted anyone in his employ or under his supervision to practice or assist in the practice of optometry, in violation of the provisions of this Chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempted to or obtained a license, registration, certificate, permit or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed repeated occasions of negligence or incompetence in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed repeated occasions of negligence or incompetence in the practice or assistance in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony directly related to the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony that the board finds is directly related to the practice of optometry pursuant to R.S. 37:2950 in the courts of any state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually intemperate or addicted to alcohol or habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is habitually intemperate or is addicted to the use of alcohol or habit-forming drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his license, permit, certification, registration or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry revoked or suspended, or has had other disciplinary action taken, or has had his application for licensure refused, revoked, or suspended by the proper authorities of another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction, government agency, or court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction, government agency, law enforcement agency, or court for conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report surrender of a license in another jurisdiction while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board the surrender of a license, permit, certification, registration, or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry in another state or jurisdiction while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report adverse judgment, settlement, or award from a malpractice claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement, or award arising from a malpractice claim related to conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departed from or failed to conform to minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing optometry practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has departed from or failed to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing optometry practice, whether or not actual injury to a patient has occurred.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice knowingly having a contagious or infectious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continued practice knowingly having a contagious or infectious disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud in connection with the practice of optometry, including Medicaid, Medicare, or insurance fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed fraud by a licensee in connection with the practice of optometry, including, but not limited to, Medicaid fraud, Medicare fraud, or insurance fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceived or defrauded the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Deceived or defrauded the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in or aided unlicensed practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged, or aided and abetted a person to engage in the practice of optometry without a license, registration, certificate, permit or any other designation deemed necessary to engage in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted another person to use his certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitted another to use his certificate of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay fines, penalties, fees, or other costs assessed in a disciplinary hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to pay fines, penalties, fees, or other costs assessed in a disciplinary hearing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert any board evaluation, investigation, or hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that subverts or attempts to subvert any evaluation, investigation, hearing, fact finding, or other examination, or the administration of any evaluation, investigation, hearing, fact finding, or other examination authorized under this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Evaded or assisted another in evading local, state, or federal laws pertaining to optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has evaded or assisted, directly or indirectly, another person in evading any local, state or federal laws or regulations pertaining to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Divulged confidential or personally identifiable patient information without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has divulged or revealed confidential information or personally identifiable information to a person other than as authorized by state or federal law or the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in false, misleading, or fraudulent advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in false, misleading, or fraudulent advertising as defined by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised or held himself out as an optometrist without a valid certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertised or held himself out to be an optometrist without having a valid certificate issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicited business from house to house or door to door
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicited business from house to house or door to door either directly or indirectly.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised with reference to controlled dangerous substances in Schedules III, IV, or V
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised by including any reference, direct or indirect, to any controlled dangerous substances as provided for in Schedules III, IV, or V of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish information legally requested by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to furnish to the board, its investigators, or representatives any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used the title 'Doctor' or 'Dr.' without using 'Optometrist' as a suffix, or used optometric degree titles without holding an accredited diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used the title of "Doctor" or "Dr." as a prefix to his name without using the term "Optometrist" as a suffix to his name or in connection with it; or used the title "Doctor of Optometry", "O.D.", "Opt. D.", or "D.O.S." without holding a diploma from an accredited school of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a professional connection with or loaned his name to an illegal practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a professional connection with or loaned his name to an illegal practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refused or neglected to display certificate to practice as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refused or neglected to display his certificate to practice as required by R.S. 37:1059.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Purchased or procured by barter a board certificate with intent to use it as evidence of qualification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Purchased or procured by barter any certificate issued by the board with intent to use it as evidence of his qualification to practice optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Materially altered a board-issued certificate with fraudulent intent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altered materially, with fraudulent intent, a certificate issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used or attempted to use a purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used or attempted to use any certificate issued by the board which has been purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conspired with or facilitated another person to violate this Chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conspired with any other person to violate this Section or any provisions of this Chapter, or in any way facilitated the violation of this Section or any provision of this Chapter by any other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated provisions relating to therapeutic certification or expanded procedures
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any provision of R.S. 37:1051(C), 1063, or 1063.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to complete required continuing education for those certified to treat abnormal conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For those who are certified by the board to treat abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye, failed to complete not less than sixteen clock hours annually of continuing education, at least fifty percent of the content of which shall be comprised of subjects relative to ocular therapy and pharmacology.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or used 'cappers' or 'steerers' to obtain business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed or used "cappers" or "steerers" to obtain business.

definition_quote.value: Optometry means that practice in which a person employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty, except for those surgery procedures specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section; measures the powers and range of vision of the human eye using subjective or objective means, including the use of lenses and prisms before the eye and autorefractors or other automated testing devices to determine its accommodative and refractive state and general scope of function; and the adaptation, sale, and dispensing of frames and lenses in all their forms, including plano or zero power contact lenses, to overcome errors of refraction and restore as near as possible, normal human vision, or for orthotic, prosthetic, therapeutic, or cosmetic purposes with respect to contact lenses.
definition_quote.quote: "Optometry" means that practice in which a person employs primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty, except for those surgery procedures specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section

value: primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery (YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, laser trabeculoplasty)
measurement of powers and range of vision using subjective or objective means
adaptation, sale, and dispensing of frames and lenses including contact lenses
examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa
vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy
ordering of appropriate diagnostic lab or imaging tests
dispensing of samples to initiate treatment
use or prescription of diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
methods_authorized.quote: Optometry also includes the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa, including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy, ordering of appropriate diagnostic lab or imaging tests; the dispensing of samples to initiate treatment; and the use or prescription of diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents.

drug_authority.value: Licensed optometrists certified by the board may use or prescribe diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, excluding Schedule I and II controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" shall not include any drug or other substance listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law provided in R.S. 40:963 and 964 which shall be prohibited from use by a licensed optometrist.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall limit an optometrist's ability to use diagnostic or therapeutic instruments utilizing laser or ultrasound technology in the performance of primary eye care or limit an optometrist's ability to perform ophthalmic surgery procedures other than those specifically excluded in Subsection D of this Section.

surgery_definition.value: A procedure upon the human eye in which in vivo human tissue is injected, cut, burned, frozen, sutured, vaporized, coagulated, or photodisrupted by the use of surgical instrumentation such as, but not limited to, a scalpel, cryoprobe, laser, electric cautery, or ionizing radiation.
surgery_definition.quote: "Ophthalmic surgery" means a procedure upon the human eye in which in vivo human tissue is injected, cut, burned, frozen, sutured, vaporized, coagulated, or photodisrupted by the use of surgical instrumentation such as, but not limited to, a scalpel, cryoprobe, laser, electric cautery, or ionizing radiation.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall prohibit the dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts, insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs, foreign body removal from superficial ocular tissue, suture removal, removal of eyelashes, drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa

value: YAG laser capsulotomy
laser peripheral iridotomy
laser trabeculoplasty
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: primary eye care procedures including ophthalmic surgery such as YAG laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty

value: dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts
insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs
foreign body removal from superficial ocular tissue
suture removal
removal of eyelashes
drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa
corneal shaping with external ophthalmic devices such as contact lenses
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Nothing in this Chapter shall prohibit the dilation and irrigation of lacrimal ducts, insertion and removal of lacrimal plugs, foreign body removal from superficial ocular tissue, suture removal, removal of eyelashes, drainage of superficial lesions of the eye and its adnexa, or corneal shaping with external ophthalmic devices such as contact lenses by optometrists

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: He shall have current certification that he has completed a basic course in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and proof that he possesses in his office an automatic epinephrine injector that is operable and on which the expiration date has not passed.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: including the use or prescription of vision therapy, ocular exercises, rehabilitation therapy, subnormal vision therapy

immunization_authority.quote: In a public health emergency, the state health officer may authorize therapeutically licensed optometrists to administer inoculations for systemic health reasons.

value: Schedule I prohibited
Schedule II prohibited
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" shall not include any drug or other substance listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Dangerous Substances Law provided in R.S. 40:963 and 964 which shall be prohibited from use by a licensed optometrist.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: "Diagnostic and therapeutic pharmaceutical agent" means any prescription or nonprescription drug delivered by any route of administration, used or prescribed for the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, or mitigation of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No optometrist shall carry out such treatment or employ such pharmaceutical agents without such certification.

value: licensed optometrist
therapeutically licensed optometrist (certified to treat abnormal conditions and pathology and use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents)
tiered_license_types.quote: These certificates or renewals thereof shall be the only evidence of the right of a person to practice optometry or therapeutic optometry.

value: Certification to treat abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa (therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certification)
Certification to perform authorized ophthalmic surgery procedures
Certification to use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents
specialty_certification_types.quote: Have demonstrated that they have reached the qualification level necessary to become certified to treat abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa as set forth in R.S. 37:1051, and the rules and regulations established, published, and administered by the board.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The required additional studies shall include a minimum of forty-six clock hours of didactic education and thirty-four clock hours of approved supervised clinical training

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: thirty-four clock hours of approved supervised clinical training which shall be the equivalent of at least five semester hours of postgraduate education in the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal conditions and pathology of the human eye and its adnexa.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Licensed optometrists certified by the board to use pharmaceutical agents may direct licensed registered nurses, licensed practical nurses and other healthcare personnel to execute diagnostic and therapeutic orders and administer pharmaceutical agents.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: The practice of optometry includes, but is not limited to, providing optometric services to a client or patient in this state through telephonic, electronic, or other means, regardless of the location of the optometrist, and shall require licensure within this state.

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: The board may, by regulation, defer action with regard to an impaired licensed, registered, or certified person who voluntarily signs an agreement, in a form satisfactory to the board, agreeing not to practice optometry and to enter an approved treatment and monitoring program

criminal_background_check_required.quote: the board may require an applicant as a condition for eligibility for licensure: (1) To submit a full set of fingerprints, in a form and manner prescribed by the board. (2) To permit the board to request and obtain state and national criminal history record information on the applicant.
